candidates.angle: Seeing wisdom and action as one
candidates.evidence: एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स पश्यति

candidates.angle: Both paths lead to the same state
Krishna removes the false split for Arjuna

angle_en: Wisdom and action as one path
angle_hi: ज्ञान और कर्म एक ही मार्ग

en.intro: Arjuna is still stuck on whether to fight or to renounce. What does Krishna say to untangle this? Listen to how he joins the two paths.
en.notice: Krishna says the state reached by wisdom is also reached through action. The one who sees both as a single path sees clearly, and that clarity is the true sight.
en.next: Krishna then says that renunciation without action is hard, and the disciplined path of yoga leads to the supreme reality.
en.meaning: The state reached by the wise is also reached through yoga. One who sees wisdom and yoga as one sees rightly.

hi.intro: अर्जुन अभी भी इस बात में उलझे हैं कि उन्हें लड़ना चाहिए या त्याग करना चाहिए। कृष्ण इसे सुलझाने के लिए क्या कहते हैं? ध्यान से सुनिए कि वे दोनों मार्गों को कैसे जोड़ते हैं।
hi.meaning: सांख्ययोगियों द्वारा जो तत्त्व प्राप्त किया जाता है, कर्मयोगियों द्वारा भी वही प्राप्त किया जाता है । अतः जो मनुष्य सांख्ययोग और कर्मयोग को फलरूप में एक देखता है, वही ठीक देखता है ॥
hi.notice: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि ज्ञान से जो स्थिति मिलती है, वही कर्म से भी मिलती है। जो दोनों को एक मार्ग के रूप में देखता है, वही स्पष्ट रूप से देखता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण कहते हैं कि बिना कर्म के त्याग करना कठिन है, और योग का अनुशासित मार्ग साधक को शीघ्र ही परम सत्य तक पहुँचा देता है।

en.intro: Arjuna is still stuck on whether to fight or to renounce. What does Krishna say to untangle this? Listen to how he joins the two paths.
en.body: The state reached by the wise is also reached through yoga. One who sees wisdom and yoga as one sees rightly. Krishna says the state reached by wisdom is also reached through action. The one who sees both as a single path sees clearly, and that clarity is the true sight. Krishna then says that renunciation without action is hard, and the disciplined path of yoga leads to the supreme reality.
